title: Zero-G Chemical Titration Lab
description: Inside a spaceship hallway converted into a zero-gravity chemistry lab, the user performs a multi-step acid-base titration using floating coffee mugs as reaction vessels. Each mug holds a different reagent, and the user must carefully combine precise volumes while obeying conservation of mass, track pH changes, and use undo/redo to correct mistakes before the solution reaches the target neutralization point.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load space_ship_hallway.glb as the environment and place the camera inside looking down the corridor. Load coffeeMug.glb five times, each tinted a different color representing reagents: red (HCl), blue (NaOH), green (H2SO4), yellow (KOH), and purple (indicator solution). Position mugs floating at varying heights along the hallway with gentle bobbing animation to simulate zero gravity. Add point lights with slight colored tints along the hallway and a main directional light. Implement a titration system: one central mug is the reaction vessel, the other four are source reagents. The user clicks a source mug to select it, then clicks the reaction vessel to pour. Each pour transfers exactly 10mL and the source mug's liquid level visually decreases (scale a colored cylinder inside each mug). Enforce conservation of mass: total volume across all mugs stays constant at 200mL. Display a pH meter HUD showing current pH calculated from combined acid-base concentrations using simplified Henderson-Hasselbalch. The indicator mug changes the reaction vessel liquid color based on pH when added. The user must reach pH 7.0 plus or minus 0.2 in exactly the right combination. Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y that reverts each pour step, restoring volumes and pH. Show a step counter requiring 10-14 steps to solve. Add a floating holographic display panel in the hallway showing current volumes, pH graph over steps, and target range. When the target pH is achieved, trigger a success animation where the hallway lights pulse green. Include a reset button. All interactions use raycasting with mouse clicks. Add tooltips on hover showing reagent name and remaining volume.
